description: Labeled 8-K summaries for filings-benchmark's quality score (ADR-0008). Made on 2026-10-08 for the 22 8-Ks in the local database (filed 2026-09-08 to 2026-10-08), by reading the text the summarizer gives the model for each (items and EX-99 exhibits, as form8k_prompt.build_prompt trims them), not the summaries. For each filing, 'facts' are what a correct summary must state: the event, who did it, the main figures. A fact's 'patterns' are regular expressions (any one matching is enough) and its 'numbers' are figures (any one stated is enough, compared by value with the grounding check's normalization, so '$1 billion' states '1.0 billion' and '16 million' states '16,000,000'); a fact with both needs both. 'forbidden' lists claims the filing contradicts: the slips seen in real summaries (Nike 'all proposals passed', Oracle cancelling Ellison's plan, Tesla's '18-month term loan', PepsiCo's year-to-date growth given as the quarter's) and a few others a careless summary would make. Patterns match case-insensitively against the headline, the summary, and each key point separately, after curly quotes and dashes are made plain. Numbers the filing never states (computed totals) are left to the grounding check. All accession numbers and quotes are public SEC data.
